name: PostModule
declaration: public enum PostModule : uint
summary: The group of settings one PostOverride entry changes.

values.name: Exposure
values.summary: Automatic metering or a fixed exposure, compensation and adaptation.

values.name: ColorGrading
values.summary: White balance, saturation, contrast, lift/gamma/gain and a lookup table.

values.name: MotionBlur
values.summary: Blur along screen motion while the shutter is open.

values.name: AmbientOcclusion
values.summary: Screen-space ambient occlusion strength and radius (presets that run it).

values.name: Reflections
values.summary: Screen-space reflection strength and reach (presets that run them).
